payload.prompt: Star Trek cinematic 3D animation. Dim amber corridor. A stocky engineer, grey temples, red tunic, alarmed, at right; a light brown-haired captain, gold tunic, at left. The engineer speaks first: "Captain, Starfleet just locked every command code you own." Then the captain answers: "Who signed it?" Each character's lips move only while they speak and stay closed otherwise. They do not stare into the lens: their gaze rests on each other and drifts naturally, with small relaxed head movements.
